name: DiseaseSpecificResearchForInference
summary: The card component of Disease Specific Research for inference (DUO_0000007). The script declares a use for a disease the owner allows. Outputs the InferenceGrantCredential that Grant inference takes.

allowedDiseases.description: Allowed MONDO disease codes. An IntendedDataUseCredential qualifies if any entry of claims.useOnlyFor.diseases is in this list.
